title: Chinese Pumpkin Farming Techniques and Tiny Tamarinds
reason: Describes unique pumpkin farming techniques and sales methods.

tasks.task: Chinese farmers produce unique pumpkins for high prices.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of unique farming techniques to produce the world's largest pumpkins.
Note the development of methods to grow the smallest pumpkins the size of a hand.
Notice the production of a tamarind fruit that sells for high prices due to its size and taste.
Watch how both types of pumpkins are sold for high prices.
